impact: Slowing activity with rising prices is a stagflation mix: it may not stop a December hike but caps growth optimism; watch yields for the read-through to GOOGL, MSFT, NBIS and MU.
summary: The Philadelphia Fed general activity index fell to 6.3 in November from 20.9, its lowest since May, against forecasts around 20; new orders dropped to -0.4 while prices paid jumped. Initial jobless claims rose 1,000 to 203,000 in the week ended Nov 14, above the 197,000 expected, and continuing claims rose 70,000 to 1.763 million.
title: Philly Fed plunges to 6.3, lowest since May; jobless claims 203K vs 197K expected
